title: gate v2 migration — SPEC-14 + npm test green
goal: Add SPEC-14 test assertions and verify npm test passes, completing the seven-gate ADR-054/ADR-055 v2 contract migration

steps.description: Write SPEC-14 red-first (before implementation is visible to test): in tests/unit/gate-v2-contract-test.sh, add a SPEC-14 block that (a) asserts all 7 manifests carry exactly one output with both required: true and summary: true — the ADR-055 §9 'required: true' requirement not yet covered by SPEC-9..13; and (b) after the existing SPEC-2 pass and skip verdict runs, asserts the summary/detail file was actually written and is non-empty for every gate. Coverage-gate, lint-gate, and mutation-gate can reuse the work dirs from SPEC-2/5 (cv-v2-pass, lt-v2-pass, mg-v2-pass, and the skip dirs) to avoid duplicate runs. Design-gate reuses dg-v2. Gate-aggregator reuses ga-v2-pass. Secret-scan and shape-floor each need one additional assertion against their existing work dirs. State the red step in the PR body: 'at merge-base, SPEC-14 fails because the manifests had required: false on the summary output and no summary file assertions existed.'

Fix secret-scan pass summary content: in plugins/tool/secret-scan/plugin.sh the pass-path call to stage_summary_write passes an empty reason string, causing the library to write '- no findings'. ADR-055 §9 requires 'a summary states what the stage DID'. Replace the empty reason with 'clean diff — no secrets found' so the summary names the stage's conclusion, not just the absence of output. This is a one-line change that makes the SPEC-14 non-empty-content assertion pass.

Run npm test with the committed tree so the mutation tier engages. Assert the full suite is green, including gate-v2-contract-test.sh SPEC-1 through SPEC-14. Verify that checking out the merge-base (before commit 6447e3f0) and running the same test file produces a red result on SPEC-14 (and on SPEC-2/4 for the fields that were absent before the migration), satisfying the 'Reddens at the merge-base' DoD item. Document the red-step assertion and how it failed in the PR body.

notes: Five commits on branch zbuild/issue-1848-ci have already completed the bulk of the migration: all seven manifests carry result_contract:2, valid_verdicts, primary:true, provides.role, provides.events, and required:true on their summary outputs; all seven plugin.sh files write result_contract:2 + disposition:complete + reason on every exit path and call stage_summary_write on every terminal verdict including early bail-outs (shape-floor's disposition:broken path included). The test file gate-v2-contract-test.sh covers SPEC-1..13. The single remaining code gap is SPEC-14 — the ADR-055 §9 supplementary acceptance addition from the issue body ('assert the summary output is required:true and written on every terminal verdict including the earliest bail-out path'). SPEC-4 already covers design-gate's feedback file, but the other six gates have no file-existence assertion. The secret-scan pass summary uses an empty reason which stage_summary_write renders as '- no findings' — technically the file is present and names the verdict, but ADR-055 §9 prefers 'what the stage DID' over bare absence language; fixing the reason string closes the gap cleanly. Router budget knobs are correctly absent from all seven manifests (T0 tools make no model calls, so timeout_s/max_turns/retries would be dead config). No hardcoded cross-stage artifact paths exist in any plugin.sh (verified by SPEC-12 grep). Gate-aggregator clears stale gate-feedback.md and design-feedback.md per #1757 fix. Design-gate defects #1714 and #1777 are intentionally carried forward per the issue scope. Step-3 has no file changes — it is a pure execution-and-documentation step (the 'npm test green + reddens at merge-base' DoD items).
